marketing_description: The Oliver Machinery Helical Cutterhead Planer (part 10045.201) delivers a 13‑in cutting width and 6‑in cutting thickness with selectable depth of cut at 1/8 in or 3/16 in. Powered by a 2 hp, 115 V, 15 A single‑phase motor, it provides feed rates of 16 fpm or 20 fpm across two speeds, operating at 60 Hz.
